title: Empowering Reliable Visual-Centric Instruction Following in MLLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical capability of Multimodal Large Language Models to follow visual-centric instructions. While it aims to make models more 'reliable' and 'aligned with human intent,' these terms are used in a technical sense of adhering to instructions rather than in a moral or ethical framework. The paper does not evaluate or benchmark any aspects of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
